exact_matrices.derivation: Global horizontal/vertical multi-twists by cylinder moduli on H1+ difference basis (γL1-γL2, γS1-γS2, δL1-δL2, δS1-δS2). These ARE the affine maps coming from the cylinder decomposition of the polygon.

spectrum_with_silver_unit_blocks.note: Unit blocks are field-compatible candidates, not yet proved to be φ_* for an affine diffeomorphism of the polygon
